description.value:
Molten-glass veins thread visible under the skin, cooled to hard glass.

Gift — Resistance 3 to fire. Tithe — Your veins are brittle where they show: a natural 20 against you in melee also inflicts 1d4 persistent bleed as a vein cracks.

cinderfall.incomplete: "A natural 20 against you in melee also inflicts 1d4 persistent bleed" has no confirmed rule-element hook: no generic 'inflict a condition on a natural 20 against you regardless of the attack's own outcome' actor-level rule element was found in pf2e-source; critical-hit consequences of this kind are normally authored on the attacking creature/weapon, not the target.
